column1: # reply-markers.tsv — the ONE list of reply markers (Issue #4532, invariant M1).
# A CLI draws a marker glyph at the head of the FIRST row of an assistant reply.
# A one-line reply therefore reads `<marker> DONE: …` / `<marker> IMPL_COMPLETED`,
# and the row normalization strips ONE of these markers (and the one blank after
# it) before a reader matches the row. Every reader takes the set from this file
# and from nowhere else:
#   bash  .claude/skills/orchestrate-monitor/scripts/monitor-lib.sh  (ML_REPLY_MARKERS)
#   JS    scripts/orchestrate/wait-verify.mjs  (readReplyMarkers / normalizePaneLine;
#         launch-worker.mjs reads it through returnLineOf)
# tests/unit/skills/orchestrate-monitor/reply-markers-4532.test.ts fails when a
# marker glyph is written into those files directly (M2), and
# monitor-ending-generated-4532.test.ts generates its cells from these rows (M3).
# Format: one marker per line, four TAB-separated fields; `#` lines are comments.
#   tool      the CLI tool id (src/lib/cli-tools/types.ts CLI_TOOL_IDS)
#   platform  `macos`, `other` (every platform but macOS) or `any`
#   marker    the glyph, exactly as drawn
#   source    where it was measured
# Not listed, because no reply row of theirs is measured: antigravity and
# copilot draw `●` on tool and notice rows (tests/fixtures/antigravity-live-2364,
# tests/fixtures/copilot-folder-trust-1080.ts), but no assistant reply row in the
# repository shows the marker a one-line reply would carry. A marker added here is
# picked up by every reader and every generated test at once.
# tool
